quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Your roommate left dirty dishes in the sink again. You feel annoyed.
quests.correctAnswer: Say something friendly
quests.hint: A gentle remark like 'Hey, could you wash these?' is direct without being aggressive.
quests.explanation: Being polite but clear stops small problems from growing into bigger ones.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Your roommate left dirty dishes in the sink again. You feel annoyed.
quests.correctAnswer: Ask calmly
quests.hint: Asking calmly shows you want to solve the problem, not start a fight.
quests.explanation: A calm tone makes the other person far more likely to listen and cooperate.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Your roommate left dirty dishes in the sink again. You feel annoyed.
quests.correctAnswer: Wait for a good moment to talk
quests.hint: Choosing the right time to speak matters. Talking when you are both relaxed leads to better results.
quests.explanation: Good timing increases the chance of a positive outcome in any difficult conversation.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A friend forgot to return your book after two weeks.
quests.correctAnswer: Remind them politely
quests.hint: A gentle reminder such as 'Did you finish my book?' is friendly and not demanding.
quests.explanation: Polite reminders preserve friendships while solving the problem.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A friend forgot to return your book after two weeks.
quests.correctAnswer: Send a short text message
quests.hint: A short text like 'Hey, any chance you still have my book?' is low-pressure and easy to answer.
quests.explanation: Text messages give the other person time to respond without feeling put on the spot.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A friend forgot to return your book after two weeks.
quests.correctAnswer: Mention it when you see them next
quests.hint: Face-to-face conversations feel natural. You can smile and say 'Oh, I actually need that book back.'
quests.explanation: Casual in-person reminders work well for small issues between friends.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Your neighbour is playing loud music at night and you cannot sleep.
quests.correctAnswer: Knock on their door and ask nicely
quests.hint: A calm direct visit is usually the fastest way to solve a noise problem.
quests.explanation: Most neighbours will turn down their music when asked politely in person.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Your neighbour is playing loud music at night and you cannot sleep.
quests.correctAnswer: Write a friendly note
quests.hint: A friendly note avoids an awkward face-to-face moment and gives your neighbour time to respond.
quests.explanation: Written notes work well when you feel too tired or anxious for a direct conversation.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Your neighbour is playing loud music at night and you cannot sleep.
quests.correctAnswer: Speak to them the following day
quests.hint: If you are very tired it may be better to rest and speak to them in the morning when you are calm.
quests.explanation: Choosing the right moment to address conflict leads to more productive conversations.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A classmate always borrows your pen and never brings their own.
quests.correctAnswer: Say 'I only have one pen, so I need it back today.'
quests.hint: Being clear about your needs is not rude - it is helpful. Use a friendly tone.
quests.explanation: Clear friendly communication sets limits without creating conflict.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A classmate always borrows your pen and never brings their own.
quests.correctAnswer: Suggest they bring their own pen next time
quests.hint: Offering a helpful suggestion like 'Maybe keep a spare pen in your bag' solves the root problem.
quests.explanation: Offering solutions rather than just complaints moves conflicts forward constructively.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A classmate always borrows your pen and never brings their own.
quests.correctAnswer: Ask them to return it before class ends
quests.hint: Asking for your pen back before you leave is practical and prevents the problem from repeating.
quests.explanation: Setting clear expectations helps manage repeated small conflicts.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Your younger sibling keeps entering your room without knocking.
quests.correctAnswer: Explain why privacy matters to you
quests.hint: Say 'I like to have my own space. Please knock first.' This teaches respect calmly.
quests.explanation: Teaching others about personal boundaries is a key life communication skill.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Your younger sibling keeps entering your room without knocking.
quests.correctAnswer: Make a simple rule together
quests.hint: Agreeing on a rule like 'always knock' gives both of you clear expectations to follow.
quests.explanation: Shared rules reduce repeated conflicts by making expectations explicit.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Your younger sibling keeps entering your room without knocking.
quests.correctAnswer: Put a note on your door
quests.hint: A small sign saying 'Please knock!' is a visual reminder that does not require a big conversation.
quests.explanation: Visual cues are a low-conflict way to communicate boundaries in a household.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A shop assistant gave you the wrong change.
quests.correctAnswer: Say politely: 'Excuse me, I think there has been a mistake with my change.'
quests.hint: Mistakes happen. A calm polite correction avoids embarrassment for everyone.
quests.explanation: Politely correcting errors shows confidence and prevents financial loss without creating conflict.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A shop assistant gave you the wrong change.
quests.correctAnswer: Count your change at the counter
quests.hint: Always count change before leaving the counter. If there is a mistake say so immediately.
quests.explanation: Checking immediately makes it easier to resolve the issue while the situation is clear.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A shop assistant gave you the wrong change.
quests.correctAnswer: Ask to speak to the manager if needed
quests.hint: If the assistant is unhelpful calmly asking for a manager is a reasonable next step.
quests.explanation: Knowing when to escalate a problem is a practical conflict resolution skill.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Your friend said something that hurt your feelings by accident.
quests.correctAnswer: Tell them calmly how it made you feel
quests.hint: Say 'That comment hurt a little. I wanted to mention it.'
quests.explanation: Sharing feelings honestly but gently strengthens friendships and prevents misunderstandings.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Your friend said something that hurt your feelings by accident.
quests.correctAnswer: Choose a quiet moment to bring it up
quests.hint: Find a time when you are both relaxed. This makes the conversation easier for both of you.
quests.explanation: Timing is important in conflict resolution - calm moments lead to better outcomes.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Your friend said something that hurt your feelings by accident.
quests.correctAnswer: Use 'I' statements to express yourself
quests.hint: Say 'I felt a bit hurt when...' instead of 'You made me feel...' This reduces defensiveness.
quests.explanation: 'I' statements keep conversations calm and are less likely to trigger defensiveness.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Two of your friends are arguing and ask you to take sides.
quests.correctAnswer: Stay neutral and listen to both
quests.hint: Say 'I care about both of you. I do not want to take sides.' Listen to each person separately.
quests.explanation: Staying neutral in a friends' argument protects all your relationships.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Two of your friends are arguing and ask you to take sides.
quests.correctAnswer: Encourage them to talk directly to each other
quests.hint: Suggest: 'Have you tried talking to each other about this? I think that would help more.'
quests.explanation: Encouraging direct communication is better than becoming a go-between in others' conflicts.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Two of your friends are arguing and ask you to take sides.
quests.correctAnswer: Offer to sit with both of them together
quests.hint: Offer to sit with both friends so everyone can speak and listen. Act as a calm presence.
quests.explanation: Facilitating a calm discussion is more effective than judging who is right or wrong.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Your teacher gave your essay a lower grade than you expected.
quests.correctAnswer: Ask politely for feedback after class
quests.hint: After class say: 'Could you help me understand what I could improve?' This shows respect and a desire to learn.
quests.explanation: Asking for feedback constructively turns disappointment into a learning opportunity.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Your teacher gave your essay a lower grade than you expected.
quests.correctAnswer: Review the marking criteria before speaking
quests.hint: Re-read the assignment criteria to understand the grade better before meeting your teacher.
quests.explanation: Understanding the criteria first makes your conversation with the teacher more productive.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Your teacher gave your essay a lower grade than you expected.
quests.correctAnswer: Write down your questions before the meeting
quests.hint: Prepare specific questions like: 'Which section needed more detail?' This shows you take the feedback seriously.
quests.explanation: Preparing for difficult conversations leads to more focused and useful outcomes.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Someone pushed in front of you in a queue.
quests.correctAnswer: Say calmly: 'Excuse me, I was next in line.'
quests.hint: A calm factual statement is assertive without being aggressive.
quests.explanation: Asserting your position clearly but calmly is the correct response to queue jumping.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Someone pushed in front of you in a queue.
quests.correctAnswer: Make eye contact and speak clearly
quests.hint: Looking at the person and speaking in a clear calm voice shows confidence without aggression.
quests.explanation: Body language and tone are as important as words in resolving minor conflicts.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Someone pushed in front of you in a queue.
quests.correctAnswer: Consider whether it is worth addressing
quests.hint: If the queue is short or you are not in a hurry sometimes choosing not to engage saves time and energy.
quests.explanation: Part of conflict resolution is knowing when a situation is worth addressing and when to let it go.
